_about: The Common Course Reference's procedures: each a rule in plain words, with who set it and when. kb/_ccr_seed_recheck_dryrun.py --doubt reads active_discipline and writes the Courses List's Discipline in doubt job (kb/ccr_doubt.json). A person's ruling there, with a reason marked for similar cards, arrives as a kb_curation ccr_procedure_request row; a session writes it here as a rule switched off, measures how many waiting cards it would settle, and switches it on with the person's word.
_updated_by: S614 SkyMilkomeda: the store and the first procedure, from Sam's ask of 2026-11-09

procedures.name: Re-check a seed discipline with two signals
procedures.rule: A common course keeps its seed discipline when its catalog description fits that discipline with a clear margin and TOP names no other. A card whose description points to another discipline, or whose colleges' TOP codes do, goes to a person, one discipline at a time.
procedures.set_by: Sam, Open Asks Sheet 173 note, 2026-11-08 (descriptions first, TOP alongside)
